Saint Gallen (Saint Gallen) — Schweiz Reiseführer: Sehenswürdigkeiten, Anreise & Spezialitäten

Historic Altstadt / Old Town, Panoramic mountain & lake views, Marked SwitzerlandMobility hiking trails, Local heritage museum. Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass.
